description: Simulates daily office tasks: drafting emails, reviewing documents, cell data entry, window navigation, and taking breaks.

scenario.message: Step 1: Focus workspace and switch window (Alt+Tab)
Step 2: Composing morning status email response

scenario.contents: Subject: Weekly Operational Summary & Action Items{ENTER}{ENTER}Hi Team,{ENTER}{ENTER}Here is the status report for today's active tasks:{ENTER}- Finalized quarterly budget spreadsheet.{ENTER}- Conducted client feedback sync.{ENTER}- Verified deployment metrics.{ENTER}{ENTER}Please let me know if any further details are required.{ENTER}{ENTER}Best regards,{ENTER}Alex - Operations{ENTER}

scenario.message: Step 3: Navigating and entering numbers into spreadsheet cells
Step 4: Reviewing report document, scrolling down and reading
Step 5: Sending quick team chat confirmation

scenario.contents: Got it! Thanks for the update, will check it now.{ENTER}

scenario.message: Step 6: Saving work (Ctrl+S) and taking a short break
